svg.aria-label: Pundoku app icon, direction D5 The Carry, small optics, tinted mono map
svg.title: Pundoku — D5 «Унос» — малая оптика — tinted / mono map
svg.desc: Luminance map iOS tints, not a finished icon. Small-optics geometry. The field is a flat grey (the composite of the 58 percent white of d5-icon-tinted.svg over the ground) and the carried cell is full white, so the carried cell stays the brightest thing in the map and nothing has to be hand-inverted.
